label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-TP — resolved sink value at line 64 is the Object[] array containing bar (which equals param + '_SafeStuff') where param is derived from request.getParameterNames(). The parameter name comes from user-controlled input and flows through StringBuilder.append('_SafeStuff').toString() to become bar, then into obj[]. The printf() call outputs this to the response without HTML encoding. Although _SafeStuff is appended, it does not sanitize the user-controlled portion. XSS vulnerability confirmed.

evidence.note: User parameter names extracted from request.getParameterNames(), assigned to param when value matches benchmark identifier
doSomething builds bar = param + '_SafeStuff' using StringBuilder, preserving user-controlled param
Object[] obj = {bar, "b"}; response.getWriter().printf("Formatted like: %1$s and %2$s.", obj); - no HTML encoding applied
